fingerprint_scope.candidate_assignment_sha256: phase 5C.1 digest over the sorted (group_id, split) pairs. It is the identity of the reviewed candidate and is preserved unchanged
excludes: labels, geometry and any model result
fingerprint_scope.holdout_sha256: digest over the holdout's group ids, its source image ids and modeling_population_sha256. It detects membership drift in the protected split; it covers no label, no metric and no model output
fingerprint_scope.split_assignment_sha256: phase 5C.2 digest over the sorted (group_id, source_image_id, split) triples. It differs from candidate_assignment_sha256 because the canonical final representation names images as well as groups, so it also moves when a group's membership changes while its split does not

physical_materialisation.note: this phase freezes membership only. No image was copied, moved, resized or converted, and no label file was written. Phase 5D materialises the detection and segmentation views from this membership

split_semantics.test: final untouched holdout. After this freeze it must not be used for model selection, architecture selection, hyperparameter tuning, augmentation tuning, image-size tuning, threshold tuning, qualitative model debugging or error-driven iteration. It may be evaluated only in the final-evaluation phase, once, after the models are frozen
split_semantics.train: may be used to fit model parameters
split_semantics.validation: may be used for model selection, hyperparameter selection, threshold and configuration decisions, and early stopping where a later protocol permits it
